description: Registry + classification for every skill the template knows about. 'ported' skills physically exist under agent-src/skills/<scope>/<group>/<name>/ and are fanned out by sync.ps1. 'catalogued' skills are classified here so a later sync can pull them from their source repo; they have no local folder yet. 'drop' entries are recorded so the decision is not silently re-litigated.

roundTripToShared.comment: Only core skills round-trip to the shared product tier (shared/dv). Project skills never sync upstream.

skills.name: aidevme-shared-scripts
skills.note: Library skill dot-sourced by Dataverse/ADO skills (Invoke-DataverseApi + auth + ProjectConfig). Ported Forge body neutralised to ADR-0003; governance modules (Wiki-Tiers, Resolve-GovernanceContext) deferred to review-later.

skills.name: aidevme-skills-sync
skills.note: Parity backstop, rewritten for the inverted source-is-committed model; double-nesting bug fixed.

skills.name: aidevme-skill-recorder
skills.note: Ports the aidevme/skill-recorder method (intent + ordered steps, generalise, UI-to-API mapping, review gate, redaction) into a skill. Name kept without hso- prefix by request.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.note: Anthropic upstream base scaffolder. Reclassified meta->delivery to match its on-disk placement (delivery batch). aidevme-skill-creator wraps it and remains in meta.

skills.name: aidevme-github
skills.note: Git + GitHub workflow (Conventional Commits, branches, issues, PRs, review comments, CI) via git CLI + GitHub MCP.

skills.name: aidevme-bicep
skills.note: Azure Bicep through the official Bicep MCP server (Azure.Bicep.McpServer, tools checked in Azure/bicep source at 399a28a) with Bicep CLI fallback: author, validate, AVM, decompile, snapshot and what-if after confirmation; never deploys. Ideas from github/awesome-copilot azure-deployment-preflight and update-avm-modules-in-bicep and microsoft/skills azure-prepare, read not copied.

skills.name: aidevme-terraform

Rules from hashicorp/agent-skills (terraform-style-guide, terraform-test, refactor-module, azure-verified-modules) and microsoft/skills azure-prepare, read not copied.

skills.name: aidevme-docs-maintenance
skills.note: This repo's markdownlint/cspell validation, cspell word sync and CODEOWNERS docs/ sync.

skills.name: aidevme-diagram-mermaid
skills.note: Validated, accessible Mermaid diagrams via the Mermaid Chart MCP server (mmdc/Kroki fallbacks); Power Platform patterns.

skills.name: aidevme-bruno
skills.note: Read-only Bruno collection (OpenCollection YAML) for the aidevme.com WordPress REST API: 9 GET requests in assets/collection/ copied to .bruno/aidevme-wordpress/, browser User-Agent, status and shape tests, check_collection.py (GET only, no literal credentials); modelled on bruno-collections/bruno-agent-skills, nothing copied (no license).

skills.name: aidevme-powershell-test
skills.note: Pester 6 unit tests for the PowerShell scripts in scripts/: BrunoFake.ps1 shadows npx (Mock npx can't replace npm's npx.ps1) so tests never reach aidevme.com; templates for the get-* scripts and sync-post-folders.ps1; run-tests.ps1 gates test files and runs Pester with NUnit and JaCoCo output. Based on .research/2026-11-04_091739_powershell-script-unit-testing.md.

skills.name: aidevme-powershell-documenter
skills.note: Creates and updates scripts/<group>/README.md from the PowerShell scripts: get-script-facts.ps1 parses each script (help, parameters, Bruno requests, throws, tests) without running it, test-readme.ps1 checks coverage, readme-hook.ps1 is the PostToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json.
